Dr. Jeff Rosenberg is a New York City chiropractor based in Midtown Manhattan, specializing in the treatment of sciatica, disc herniation, neck pain, back pain, spine-related and nerve conditions.
On this channel, Dr. Rosenberg shares real-world chiropractic insights, patient education, and treatment explanations designed to help people understand the root causes of pain and how to resolve them without unnecessary guesswork.
Dr. Rosenberg is the founder of Rosenberg Wellness Center, a Midtown Manhattan chiropractic practice serving professionals, athletes, and active individuals throughout New York City.
If you are searching for information on sciatica, spinal disc injuries, neck pain, or chiropractic care in New York City—especially Midtown Manhattan—this channel is designed to provide clarity, education, and practical guidance.
